title: notification inhibition doesn't restore after crash/restart
line: Notifications stay hidden during screen sharing even after Plasma restarts or crashes.
explanation: Apps such as the screen-sharing portal call Inhibit once and keep their D-Bus connection open. The notification server kept these inhibitions only in plasmashell's memory, so a restart dropped them and the app never re-sent them, letting notifications pop up again. The server now saves inhibitions (cookie, holder's D-Bus name, app, reason, hints) to a file in XDG_RUNTIME_DIR named after the session bus ID, and on startup restores those whose holder is still on the bus, re-watching it and keeping cookies so a later UnInhibit still works.

commits.message:
libnotificationmanager: restore app inhibitions after a restart

Inhibitions were only kept in plasmashell's memory, so after it crashed
or restarted, notifications showed up again while e.g. sharing a screen.
They're now saved in the runtime dir and restored if the app still runs.

BUG: 509755

media.caption: Master: an app holds a notification inhibition, plasmashell restarts, and the next notification pops up anyway
With the fix: after the same restart the inhibition is restored (Do Not Disturb icon in the tray) and no popup appears
